releaseNotes: Replaced redundant power builder pop-up and in-place button with direct power record generation; replaced manual action dropdown with dynamic Action extra/flaw derivation and conflict validation; formatted real-time stats with measurements in parentheses (e.g. Range: Ranged (1 mile)) without vertical bars; introduced dedicated Power Feats and Drawbacks row with full legality validation; implemented bidirectional [ ] Linked effect checkbox; streamlined power arrays with Dynamic primary checkbox; updated Affliction degree labels to concise failure ranges.
